title: Fixed Weighted Fly Arm and Guided Screw Press
description: One newly authored whole fixed weighted-fly-arm screw-press-inspired exterior. A broad chamfered ground sole and full tapered pedestal carry one complete thick continuous open C-shaped main casting with a deep empty work interval. Two full crown support cheeks carry a complete annular upper nut exterior. One entire vertical screw core with a continuous coarse square-profile helical rib meets a separate complete square guided ram, blunt lower nose and paired full guide blocks. A whole long horizontal fly arm has two complete rounded ball weights, a full central hub and a separate complete downward handle grip. A full stop collar with a side locking-grip exterior lies below the fly-arm hub. The lower bed has a full annular bolster around a shallow open blind recess, not a claimed through passage. Every coordinate is newly authored. This is not the rack-pinion arbor press enlarged or recolored: it has no rack teeth, side pinion or single rising rack lever, and instead has the complete screw/nut/guided-ram and two-weight fly-arm organization. It is not a fruit basket press without its basket, and it has no timber portal, stave cage, collector or pressing platen in a vessel. It is not a pierced H-frame press with a pump removed: the complete asymmetric open C casting, top cheeks and transverse weighted arm are different full structures. No accepted machine mesh or subassembly imported. One whole model zero scenes. Empty static low-poly exterior only; no workpiece, screw engagement specification, stroke, motion, pressing force, thread mechanics, inertia, working clearance, metal forming, manufacture, stability, engineering or safety capability made or verified. Blunt nose, no sharp tool. Rigging animation physics interaction not made.
